architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management library (use React context if needed).

tickets.title: Create Hero Landing page (sugidev_hero_landing)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable Button component from button_showcase_component_reference. Use CSS modules for styling. Ensure responsive layout matches design.
acceptance_criteria: Component renders pixel-perfect to Stitch design

tickets.title: Build Showcase Explore section (sugidev_showcase_explore_section)
tickets.description: Create React component for showcase section. Extract Badge component from badge_showcase_component_reference. Use CSS grid for layout. Add smooth scroll animations if specified in design.

tickets.title: Implement Services & Projects page (sugidev_services_projects)
tickets.description: Convert services/projects Stitch screen to React. Reuse Button/Badge components. Create ProjectCard component if repeated patterns exist. Ensure tabbed interface works if present.

tickets.title: Create Marquee About section (sugidev_marquee_about_section)
tickets.description: Build marquee/about section. Implement marquee animation using CSS if required. Extract any reusable text/image components.

tickets.title: Build Footer section (sugidev_collection_footer_section)
tickets.description: Convert footer Stitch design to React. Ensure social links functional. Add newsletter signup if present (form validation).
acceptance_criteria: Social icons link to correct URLs

tickets.title: Implement Contact & Project Inquiry pages
tickets.description: Create Contact and Project Inquiry pages. Reuse form components. Add client-side validation. Ensure form submission states (loading/success/error) match design.

tickets.title: Create Insights page (insights_clean_background)
tickets.description: Convert insights Stitch screen to React. Implement any blog/post card components. Ensure filtering/sorting works if specified.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Implement navigation bar with active state. Set up React Router with lazy loading for pages. Ensure 404 page exists. Add global styles if needed.
